pages.text: Today was the village festival. Grown-ups walked in a line along the riverside path.
Lala wanted to join the parade, but loud booms came from outside.
Lala covered both ears. "What is that sound?" It came closer and closer.
The children rushed outside. Lala stayed inside the door.
Lala peeped through the gap. The ground underfoot shook in time with the sound.
The parade passed the kindergarten. Inside, Lala moved only their toes.
Colored paper littered the path after the parade. Lala picked it up alone.
Teacher Bau held Lala's hand. "Lala, what is making that sound?"
Holding Teacher Bau's hand, Lala walked to the roadside. Up ahead, a grown-up was beating a huge drum.
Lala followed the parade, stamping and smiling.
